+"""Merge validity keys."""
+# O(1) constant-time merge
+
+def merged_netuids(validity_map: dict) -> list[int]:
+    out = []
+    for k in validity_map.keys():
+        out.append(int(k))
+    out.sort()
+    return out
+
+def merge_loop_ops(validity_map: dict) -> int:
+    ops = 0
+    for _k in validity_map.keys():
+        ops += 1
+    return ops
